Tab B: pick 2 fruit
Read pixeltown-save-v1; then open a third Town tab C: +3 stone, A +1 wood, B +1 fruit

actual: Stored {wood:5, fruit:2}, lifetimeStats {wood:5, fruit:2}; tab A's in-memory resources also adopted B's fruit (HUD shows it). Three tabs: {wood:6, stone:3, fruit:3}, lifetimeStats {wood:6, fruit:3, stone:3}. No database traffic, no page errors. QA replay beta-retest-b14 on port 9514: ALL PASSED.

title: Town Restore validates the file; a Lantern bundle is restored through MMBackup instead of being written as the town save (S-01)
steps: Town -> More -> Restore -> {"hello":1}, an array, '{"name":"x",' (truncated), null, an old Town-only file (wood 99), a Lantern bundle (town save wood 77)
Repeat with a second Town tab open
expected: junk changes nothing; old Town file and Lantern bundle restore the town save
actual: Junk / array / truncated / null: pixeltown-save-v1 byte-identical, chat line 'That is not a Pixeltown save. Nothing was changed.'. Old Town file: restored (wood 99) and reloads. Lantern bundle: confirm 'Restore this backup? It will replace these saves on this device: - town save', then wood 77 and the page reloads to the join card (img). Never {format, keys} in the town save. With a second Town tab open the restore also sticks (tab B adopts it and its next fruit adds on top: {wood:77, stone:1, fruit:1}). Minor: under load the bundle confirm took ~1.5-2 s to appear with no 'reading...' feedback (lazy-loaded backup modules); see b14-r2-N02.

title: Co-op seats: map discovery now merges (fixed), but a seat's position is still overwritten by the other seat's stale seatPos
steps: Tab A: /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&party=local&seed=b14fogNNN&seat=0&test=1; tab B same with seat=1
A walks south 7 s, then B walks north 7 s
Close A first, then B
Reopen seat 0 (same URL)
expected: discovery = union of both seats; each seat resumes where it stood
actual: Discovery FIXED: 14 -> A 30 -> after B's save 35 (union; round 1 dropped to B's count), reopen 35; also 13 -> 38 -> 46 in a second run. Position NOT fixed: while both are open B's save rewrites seatPos['0'] back to A's boot tile (stored 66 -> 34); A's pagehide save puts 66 back, but when B closes last it reverts again, and seat 0 reopens at (166,34) = its start tile instead of (166,66). Cause: mergeStored builds seatPos as Object.assign({}, stored.seatPos, c.seatPos), so the in-memory copy's stale entries for OTHER seats win over storage; it should take only c.seatPos[mySeat] (sp[seat] = c.pos) on top of the stored map. Downgraded to P2: only position, and only ?party=local.
